goal.raw_text: The Customer selects won auction items, chooses a shipping method, and completes payment via PayPal or Amazon Payments to finalize their order.

claims.content: Customer
The Customer has won at least one auction item that has not yet been paid for.
The Customer has previously selected either PayPal or Amazon Payments as their default method of payment.
The Customer clicks the 'Winnings Alert' link or navigates to the 'Returning Winners Payments' page after winning an auction with PayPal or Amazon Payments selected as their default payment method.

trigger.raw_text: The Customer clicks the 'Winnings Alert' link or navigates to the 'Returning Winners Payments' page after winning an auction with PayPal or Amazon Payments selected as their default payment method.

claims.content: The Customer clicks the 'Winnings Alert' link or navigates to the 'Returning Winners Payments' page.
The system displays a list of won but unpaid items, and the Customer selects the items they wish to pay for using the 'Pay Now' checkboxes.
The Customer chooses a shipping method from the available options (e.g., USPS Standard or Expedited).
The Customer selects a checkout option: PayPal, Amazon Payments, or Checkout Later.
If PayPal is selected, the Customer is redirected to the PayPal-hosted checkout page to complete the transaction.
If Amazon Payments is selected, the Amazon Payments checkout widget loads on the page for the Customer to complete the transaction.
Upon successful completion of the payment via PayPal or Amazon, the Customer is returned to a Thank You page.

If the Customer selects 'Checkout Later', the system grays out the page, disables all links, and displays a message stating that payment can be made within 7 days (168 hours), but unpaid orders will be cancelled after this window expires.

If the Customer fails to complete payment within seven days (168 hours) of the auction's closing date/time, the order is automatically cancelled, the item is placed into a 'Hold' status, and the customer's account may be suspended or locked into 'Review Status'.

If the Customer selects 'Checkout Later', the system displays a message confirming they can return to pay within 7 days (168 hours), but warns that unpaid orders will be cancelled after this window expires.

Customers who fail to pay for auction winnings more than three times in a twelve-month period (unless less than 10% of total winnings) are subject to an escalation policy where they cannot bid again until a Customer Service Rep removes the account from Review Status and they update their account with a credit card.
The Customer is returned to a Thank You page which includes the global header and footer, and a prominent link to the JTVauctions.com home page.
